objective: Consolidated BUKLOD Points R3 + Kingdom R13 isolated OTA release candidate: preserve current main changes, complete verified reward flows, and protect Character, game progress, ads and production release gates without publishing.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: GitHub source baseline main commit afdeb8f4ad3034328235a77342720c04212106c2, independent Points PR #560 head 535e93e29495b69be7b7fd9e3cedabfe03b04005 and Kingdom PR #551 head 0d0ba3d7f547c6bd477e1ec6c82ab6a5f1f1ab78. Their changed path sets do not overlap current main; consolidated integration commit 5414aba263a5ee52ef83c06448bd3184b9f46011. GitHub main is NOT proof of the live Android/web release identity. 17 SQL migrations passed rollback-only SQL preflight; none of the new R2/R3 features were applied. Device acceptance waived, never passed.
chosenApproach: Combine non-overlapping feature PRs on isolated main-based branch, retain all code/test coverage and guarded SQL, run whole integrated release gates, protect V28 pinned Android runtime/Character assets, and hold OTA/web until missing authoritative game credit and runtime approval evidence is resolved.
selectionRationale: Original separate PRs independently passed source checks but combined PR triggered one-scope-manifest rule. One complete integration-specific risk and path manifest preserves accountability while avoiding blanket gate bypass or release of unverified client-only score rewards.

Incremental verified integrations with real ledger and approved validation workflows (chosen).
Replace all 13 station games with a monolithic new engine and downloadable binaries; rejected due to regression, startup size, security and APK compatibility risks.
Deploy 39 separate web applications; rejected as an initial solution due to inconsistent Android ad/audio/offline experiences and large integration burden.
